title: Counting Sort State Predicate
statement: Let $\mu$ be an initial memory, $A$ the counting sort parameters, $i,c,p\in\mathbb{Z}$, $R$ a predicate on memories, and $\sigma$ a state. The state satisfies the counting sort state predicate if there are integers $c,p$ and a memory map $\mu'$ such that $\sigma$ is the state associated with $A,i,c,p,\mu'$, the memories $\mu$ and $\mu'$ agree outside the destination and counter regions, and $R(\mu')$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: state has the form associated with A, i, c, p, and μ′ for some c,p∈ℤ and memory μ′
μ and μ′ agree outside the destination and counter regions
